meta.description: astria vs question-derived rg+source-read baseline (harness method name: question-rg-plus-source-windows) over the scripts/bench/external corpora — Click 8.1.8 (934813e), Express 4.21.2 (1faf228), ripgrep 14.1.1 (4649aa9) — structural graphs only, o200k_base, identical complete-line clipping, failed queries kept in denominators
meta.provenance_note: CLI 1.0.7 built from b0a9c2e with a dirty tree (in-progress astria-embed model swap; structural runs never load the embedder). Per-run provenance (artifact hashes, corpus commits, golden hashes) is in each payload.
meta.reproduce: node scripts/bench/external/run.mjs produces the 1000/4000 points for both methods; the 250/500 points extend the curve via scripts/bench/quality/run-quality.mjs --root bench-work/external/<corpus> --golden scripts/bench/external/<corpus>.jsonl --astria packages/astria-cli/dist/index.js --budget <b> [--baseline]. The runner requires a fresh bench-work/external (it refuses a corpus dir that already has a graph).
meta.depth_note: query depth 3 (run-quality default; the external runner does not pass --depth). The paired Graphify protocol used depth 2; these numbers are not interchangeable with it.
